verdict.rationale: Apify publishes a full OpenAPI spec (apify-probe-2) and extensive docs with runnable code snippets for JS/Python clients (apify-docs-15,16,21,24,26), showing API usage in practice. However, there is no direct evidence of an interactive 'try it out' console or live sandbox for API calls within the docs themselves. Missing for 10: confirmation of an interactive Swagger/Redoc-style API explorer, evidence of in-browser runnable code execution, and independent user reports of using such interactivity.
